name: loopthink-google-ads
description: Ask Google Ads in plain language. Campaigns, keywords and costs. No API key, no setup.

interface.longDescription:
Ask Google Ads in plain language. Campaigns, keywords and costs. No API key, no setup.

What you can ask:
- What did each campaign cost and convert last week?
- Which keywords spend money without converting?
- Which search terms triggered my ads in the last 30 days?
- Add these search terms as negative keywords.
- Lower the daily budget of my most expensive campaign to 30 euros.

How it works:
1. Add the app and sign in with Google or Microsoft. Your Loopthink account is created on the spot.
2. Connect Google Ads with the Google account that has access to your ad accounts, and pick the accounts to share.
3. Ask in ChatGPT. Nothing needs refreshing after you connect.

Changes, with guard rails:
- Reports work right away. Changes only where your workspace turns on "Allow changes" for the account.
- The app creates and updates budgets, campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords and negative keyword lists.
- It never starts a campaign and never removes anything. New campaigns are created paused, and you switch them on in Google Ads.
- Every change is checked with Google first, and ChatGPT asks you before it is applied.
- No developer token and no API key. Your Google sign-in stays in Loopthink and never passes through ChatGPT.

Agencies and manager accounts:
- Client accounts under a manager account (MCC) work. You pick which ones the app may use.

Built for teams:
- Every person signs in with their own account.
- Access is granted per member group, reports and changes separately.
- Every report and every change is logged with who ran it, including the values before and after.
capabilities: Show whether Google Ads is connected and how to connect it
List the Google Ads accounts you can use, including client accounts under a manager account
Report campaigns, ad groups, ads and keywords: cost, clicks, impressions, CTR and conversions
Report the search terms that triggered your ads
Create and update budgets, campaigns, ad groups, ads and keywords, with a preview before applying
Add negative keywords and fill negative keyword lists
Never starts a campaign and never removes anything; new campaigns are created paused
defaultPrompt: What did each campaign cost and convert last week?
Which keywords spent the most without a conversion in the last 30 days?
Add the search terms without conversions as negative keywords.

positive.description: See whether Google Ads is connected
positive.prompt: Is my Google Ads account connected?
positive.expected_behavior: Report Google Ads as connected and name the Loopthink server it belongs to, or give the connect link if it is not connected.

positive.prompt: What did each campaign cost and convert in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Call google_ads_report with the customerId, resource "campaign", metrics such as cost_micros, clicks and conversions, and dateRange LAST_7_DAYS, and return one row per campaign with cost converted from micros.

positive.prompt: Which keywords spent the most without a conversion in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Call google_ads_report with resource "keyword_view", the keyword text as a dimension, metrics cost_micros and conversions, and dateRange LAST_30_DAYS, and list the keywords with cost and zero conversions.

positive.prompt: Which search terms triggered my ads this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Call google_ads_report with resource "search_term_view", the search term as a dimension, metrics clicks and impressions, and dateRange THIS_MONTH, and return the search terms.

positive.prompt: Show me what would change if I set the daily budget of my most expensive campaign to 30 euros. Do not apply it.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the campaign and its budget resource name with google_ads_report, then call google_ads_mutate with an update on campaign_budget (amountMicros 30000000) and dryRun true, and show the validated change without applying it.

negative.prompt: Enable my paused campaign so it starts spending today.
Delete all campaigns that had no conversions last month.

negative.description: No accounts outside the connected ones
negative.prompt: Show me the campaigns of Google Ads account 123-456-7890.

review.commerce_description: Loopthink does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Subscriptions are purchased on www.loopthink.ai.

publication.release_notes: Every tool hint is an explicit boolean. Reads: readOnlyHint true, destructiveHint false, openWorldHint false, idempotentHint true. google_ads_mutate: readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint true (updates overwrite existing values, although nothing is ever removed), openWorldHint true (it changes ads Google serves to the public), idempotentHint false. Fixed report filters that failed with a GAQL syntax error.
